_comment: MOCK REHEARSAL of stage 5 OF 5 of the security study (#358) — the same phases on the mock adapter, nothing sent to a venue. Run all five with `security_cert_cli.py run --profile-dir configs/autotrader_profiles/mock/security_cert`. A mock session is a dry run, which persists the baseline but not the position book, so stage 5 finds no lot to take over here. A mock session starts from the balance it declares, so this one declares a little less than the 1000 USD stage 4 took as its baseline — the state the real account is in after stage 4's buy.

deployment._comment: A stage of the security study, never a deployment: each session is its own one-off.

cold_start._comment: The stage restarts unattended and must take over the kept lot without asking.
